question: Is the five-week signal spatially associated with J0830?

post_initial_motion_check.status: Added after unregistered maps showed shared dipoles; one bounded check, not an optimized family
post_initial_motion_check.method: Independent bright-control positive-moment centroid within fixed 2.5px radius; cubic image translation; crop two edge pixels for maps

limitations: Calibrated TESSCut full-frame pixels are another reduction of the same TESS exposures, not an independent instrument.
Only about two proposed cycles; free scans do not supply formal period precision.
Spatial centers are descriptive fits, not calibrated position intervals; unresolved blends remain possible.
Controls were selected from catalogue geometry before light-curve inspection; both retained even if variable.
Signed spatial maps are conditional on the fixed period and primary aperture phase.
Interpolation can change undersampled peak pixels; aperture and spatial results are model-dependent.
